assumptions.statement_zh: 组织方尚未发布官方总体边界与重点区域 polygon，本方案全部几何为 provisional 临时粗略约束，仅用于内容设计与机器校验；官方图形发布后必须整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: No official boundary or key-area polygons are published yet; all geometry here is provisional and must be recomputed when official data arrives.

assumptions.statement_zh: 容积率、建筑高度等法定控制条件未知，本方案不给出任何具体数值结论，仅保留概念口径的示意。
assumptions.statement_en: Statutory controls (FAR, height) are unknown; this proposal makes no numeric conclusions about them.

assumptions.statement_zh: 企业、人才与社区数据仅作概念画像，不涉及任何真实个体或企业信息，不替代官方统计。
assumptions.statement_en: Enterprise, talent and community profiles are conceptual only; no real individuals or firms are referenced.

assumptions.statement_zh: 原点广场、街坊AI学院与智巷设施均为原创概念建议，指向示范性、可逆化的模块化设施，不构成建设承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: All facilities are original reversible conceptual proposals, not construction commitments.

assumptions.statement_zh: AI 政务咨询与社区议事仅提供匿名聚合与人工复核兜底，不设个体识别采集，不设无法人工终止的自动决定。
assumptions.statement_en: AI civic services use anonymous aggregation with human review; no irreversible automated decisions.

assumptions.statement_zh: 年度活动体系与运营机制均为建议性设计，不代表已确定的政府安排或投资承诺。
assumptions.statement_en: The annual event system is a design suggestion, not a confirmed government arrangement.

assumptions.statement_zh: 三层范围名称与面积按官方公告口径使用：统筹研究范围约43.6平方公里、总体设计范围约11.4平方公里、重点区域范围约368.4公顷（来源 DATA-SRC-OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT-20260509）；本包自定义研究子范围约1.1平方公里（北京AI原点社区所在街坊）改称本包子范围，位于总体设计范围之内；本包概念几何仅作总体设计范围的展示底图，非官方红线，官方数据发布后整体复算。
assumptions.statement_en: The three-level scope names and areas follow the official announcement: coordinated research about 43.6 km2, overall design about 11.4 km2, key areas about 368.4 ha (source DATA-SRC-OFFICIAL-ANNOUNCEMENT-20260509); the package custom research sub-scope of about 1.1 km2 (AI Origin Community neighbourhood) is renamed the package sub-scope and sits inside the overall design scope; the package concept geometry is only a display basemap for the overall design scope, not an official red line, and is fully recalculated when official data is published.
